segments.title: The 'first reptile' was really...?
segments.say: This fossil was called the first reptile. What was it really? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: NOT a reptile!
segments.say: Not a reptile! It had gills and a fish-like mouth.

segments.title: 345 million years old
segments.say: It's three hundred forty five million years old, found in Scotland. Nickname: Lizzie.

segments.title: Source: Nature
segments.say: New X-ray scans, in the journal Nature.
Follow for Guess It number 36 tomorrow.
